decisions.what: Type definitions for LayerConfig, LayerMetadata, DefaultLayers enum, and DEFAULT_LAYER_CONFIGS array
decisions.why: Foundation task that defines the contract used by LayerManager, CanvasEngine, main.ts, and both test files.

decisions.what: LayerManager warns via console.warn (with lint-disable) rather than throwing on duplicate/missing layers
decisions.why: Spec explicitly says to 'emit warnings for duplicate layer names' and use validation; throwing would break existing engine initialization paths.

decisions.what: CanvasEngine stores LayerManager as nullable and creates it in init() after building the world container
decisions.why: Matches spec ('after creating main container, instantiate LayerManager') and preserves existing init/destroy semantics.

decisions.what: CanvasEngine adds Grid to the background layer instead of directly to world
decisions.why: Explicit spec requirement for multi-layer rendering to work with z-ordering.
Avoids silent null-dereference bugs and gives an actionable error under strict TypeScript.

decisions.what: CanvasEngine integration test mocks Application.prototype.init and destroy
decisions.why: jsdom cannot provide a WebGL context, so PixiJS Application.init() would fail; stubbing lets us exercise the real CanvasEngine wiring.

decisions.what: main.ts uses Graphics.rect(...).fill(...) API for test sprites
decisions.why: Matches PixiJS v8 API declared in package.json (pixi.js ^8.0.0).
